metadata.title: Cloudphone Agent WebRTC Core Implementation Contract
metadata.description: Strict observable requirements derived solely from frozen Phase 2C.5A evidence and closed Phase 2C.4 transport contracts.

requirements.observable_behavior: The cloudphone-agent WebRTC core links against github.com/pion/webrtc/v3 v3.3.6, matching verbatim rodata string in Lane A AMD64 (0xb5f1b0) and ARM64 (0x6bd161) binaries.
requirements.notes: Exact version established independently in Phase 2C.5A.

requirements.requirement: Agent operates as WebRTC Offer Initiator in tri-party topology
requirements.observable_behavior: Signaling server (/register_agent, /connect_client) acts strictly as a WebSocket relay. Agent initiates CreateOffer upon client request, Browser Client answers with SDP answer.
requirements.notes: Signaling server creates zero PeerConnections; all WebRTC termination is on the Agent.

requirements.requirement: Agent generates SDP Offer with local description set
requirements.observable_behavior: On client connection / request-offer, Agent calls CreateOffer and SetLocalDescription, producing an SDP offer payload dispatched via signaling.

requirements.requirement: Agent receives and sets remote SDP Answer
requirements.observable_behavior: When client returns SDP answer over signaling forward envelope, Agent calls SetRemoteDescription to transition PeerConnection to stable state.
Agent publishes local ICE candidates via signaling envelope and accepts remote ICE candidates via AddICECandidate.

requirements.requirement: Confirmed video codec H.264 at 90000 Hz
requirements.observable_behavior: MediaEngine registers video/H264 with clock rate 90000. SDP contains H.264 m=video line.
requirements.notes: Disassembly xref: main.main (0x9bc7a1 AMD64, 0x51e7f0 ARM64). Other Pion default codecs excluded.

requirements.requirement: Confirmed audio codec Opus at 48000 Hz, 2 channels, minptime=10
requirements.observable_behavior: MediaEngine registers audio/opus with clock rate 48000, 2 channels, and fmtp 'minptime=10'. SDP contains Opus m=audio line.

requirements.requirement: Video track display_0 constructed via NewTrackLocalStaticSample
requirements.observable_behavior: Agent creates video track with ID 'display_0' and Stream ID 'display_0' using webrtc.NewTrackLocalStaticSample and attaches it to PeerConnection.

requirements.requirement: Audio track audio_0 constructed via NewTrackLocalStaticSample
requirements.observable_behavior: Agent creates audio track with ID 'audio_0' and Stream ID 'audio_0' using webrtc.NewTrackLocalStaticSample and attaches it to PeerConnection.

requirements.requirement: Three outbound DataChannels created by Agent (input-channel, clipboard-channel, camera-channel)
requirements.observable_behavior: Agent creates 3 DataChannels before offer creation with ordered=true: 'input-channel', 'clipboard-channel', 'camera-channel'. In Phase B1, inert lifecycle hooks are attached for negotiation parity; business logic is DEFERRED.
requirements.notes: Ordered=true confirmed by byte pointer 0x1 in AMD64 (0x9e1f4f) and ARM64 (0x53e588). Full business logic deferred to B2-B4.

requirements.requirement: Three inbound DataChannels handled via OnDataChannel (file-channel, ai-command-channel, adb-channel)
requirements.observable_behavior: Agent registers OnDataChannel listener recognizing 'file-channel', 'ai-command-channel', and 'adb-channel'. In Phase B1, inert lifecycle hooks are attached for negotiation parity; business logic is DEFERRED.
requirements.notes: Dispatch site: 0x9e2f40 AMD64, 0x53f234 ARM64. Full business logic deferred to B2-B4.

requirements.observable_behavior: Agent connects to /register_agent, sends {"type":"agent_register","device_id":"...","is_webrtc":true}, and receives {"message_type":"agent_register_ok","status":"valid"}.
requirements.notes: Verified against original signaling binary in Phase 2C.4BR (TR-DIFF-AGT-REGISTER-OK).

requirements.requirement: Signaling message exchange via forward envelope with client_id correlation
requirements.observable_behavior: Agent exchanges offer, answer, and ice-candidate messages wrapped in forward envelopes carrying client_id, allowing multiplexing across multiple concurrent client sessions.

requirements.requirement: Session teardown on client_disconnected notification or connection failure
requirements.observable_behavior: Agent terminates PeerConnection cleanly upon receipt of {"message_type":"client_disconnected","client_id":...} or when PeerConnection enters failed/closed state. Cleanup is idempotent and race-safe.

requirements.requirement: Reconstructed internal state machine and sample writer interfaces
requirements.observable_behavior: Internal session states and interfaces VideoSampleSource / AudioSampleSource facilitate clean modular design and synthetic sample feeding.
requirements.notes: Internal state names (Connecting, HaveLocalOffer, etc.) are implementation choices, not literal original enum symbols.

triggers.action: Close PeerConnection associated with client_id, release tracks, unbind session
Trigger session cleanup and notify signaling/coordinator
Idempotently release remaining local session resources
Close all active PeerConnection sessions and attempt reconnection to signaling
